mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, it is a comfortable 70 degrees at Verona Area High School. You can also look forward to an ISS pass tonight, which will be visible starting at 5:01 PM as it travels from Middleton in the northwest toward Madison in the northeast.

The City of Verona has announced that municipal buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, and please note that refuse and recycling pickup will be delayed until Friday, November 27.
Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, while tomorrow offers yoga at Insight Wellness and more live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In our weekly report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct following a domestic disturbance.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
